stages.title: Shell selection
stages.desc: Only mature coconut shells. Sorted by hand for soil and sand, then carbonized in drum kilns.

stages.title: Crush and extrude
stages.desc: Charcoal is crushed to mesh, mixed with a food-grade tapioca binder and pressed into 25 mm cubes. No chemical accelerants.

stages.title: Oven drying
stages.desc: Thirty-six hours at controlled heat. We probe at five points until the core is dry.

stages.title: Ignition and ash test
stages.desc: A sample is burned from every 500 kg. It has to glow evenly, with no sparks and no smell.

stages.title: Stuffing and seal
stages.desc: The empty container is inspected and lined. Cartons are floor-stacked, the door is sealed and the seal number is photographed.

trustEvidence.label: Audit & Physical Proof
trustEvidence.title: Real Facilities. Documented Stuffing. Verified Legal.
trustEvidence.subtitle: We operate physical manufacturing and export processing facilities in Gresik (East Java) and Medan (North Sumatra). Inspect our stuffing operations and government-verified compliance documentation.
trustEvidence.g1Desc: 350 MT buffer capacity • 12 moisture-isolated staging bays • Palletized master cartons.
trustEvidence.g2Desc: 40ft HC loading under strict humidity control • Super Dry desiccant poles placed • Temperature logged.
trustEvidence.g3Desc: Direct 25 km transport corridor to Port of Tanjung Perak (IDSUB) • Gantry crane vessel loading.
trustEvidence.g4Desc: Tamper-evident customs bolt seal locked on site • Seal serial number recorded on Bill of Lading.
trustEvidence.verifyNotice: Official government and laboratory certificates issued to registered legal entity. Watermarked for anti-theft protection.
